notes: Clean security lane: no quantifiable, reproducible exploit in the 41 assigned files. Removed scope (ACTION-REVIEW-SEC-004): acdsl/README.md and routines/README.md are in the chunk diff but filtered from the security manifest by the relevance filter (README docs); not examined. Known-ledger overlaps not re-reported: security-MIN-3-r2 (policy guard bypass), security-MAJ-4-r1 (additionalDirectories reconcile), correctness-MAJ-24-r1 (acdsl ask rules removed), correctness-BLK-22-r1 (bootstrap settings.local.json overwrite), correctness-MAJ-10-r2 (install.env quoting). Cross-chunk for the station: (1) routines/smine-nightly/run.sh stage 3 now auto-runs /smine-orchestrate (judge, merge into main, sync to ~/.claude) by default on casual installs right after auto-apply=decide; whether the orchestrate skill refuses to merge+sync permission-widening changes (settings.json allow rules, cmd/hooks) produced by the unattended apply stage is decided in skills/smine/smine-orchestrate (other chunk) — related to known security-MAJ-8-r1. (2) install.env is sourced as shell by install.sh and sync_settings.sh; if configserver -install or any configserver HTTP handler writes install.env from request-supplied values (other chunk), that is a shell-injection sink. (3) cmd/bootstrap/run.sh logs to ${TMPDIR:-/tmp}; whether the configserver-spawned bootstrap inherits TMPDIR is decided in internal/server/bootstrap.go and the configserver plist (other chunk).
